envelope.description: The step tools pass 'repo-indexing' on; end-to-end refusal through the daemon

body.title: The step tools pass 'repo-indexing' on; end-to-end refusal through the daemon
body.summary: The analyze step and the one-shot analyze (src/daemon/steps) map RepoIndexingError to an error reply with code 'repo-indexing' and the figures; the workflow steps, triage and code review pass that reply on unchanged. An integration test drives analyze.context.buildRun and the step tools through step.call on a repository being indexed. Grounding: step.call is registered at src/daemon/index.ts:1902 and analyze.context.buildRun at :1740; the step table src/daemon/steps/host.ts maps insrc_analyze (runAnalyzeOneShot) and insrc_analyze_step (handleAnalyzeStep). The pass-through claim is proven by the t15 integration test, not assumed.
acceptanceChecks: analyze.context.buildRun and insrc_analyze / insrc_analyze_step through step.call on a repository being indexed return code 'repo-indexing' with the figures.
A workflow step that reaches the analyzer passes the reply on unchanged.

tests.name: analyze through the daemon (analyze.context.buildRun and the step tools via step.call) on a repository being indexed returns code 'repo-indexing' with the figures; the workflow step that reaches it passes the reply on unchanged
